platforms.name: Atlas Capture
platforms.notes: Official site reviewed. Consumer capture tasks require an iPhone 11 or newer and task availability/pay vary by country. The standard consumer recording workflow requires a supported iPhone; verify device compatibility and country availability before spending money or attempting signup. Recording must be genuine and human-performed; do not automate task recording or submissions.

platforms.name: Braintrust
platforms.notes: User supplied the official Talent dashboard URL. Braintrust's current Terms list restricted territories (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria and specified Ukrainian regions); Kenya is not named in that list, but account eligibility and role-specific country restrictions still need confirmation. Profile must be truthful; ID/location and financial-account verification may be requested. Treat Braintrust as a vetted professional talent marketplace, not a generic microtask site. Current public talent page describes AI skills interview and certification; profile creation and application remain human-reviewed. Verify Kenya payout method in the account before investing significant time.
